name: Bal Swasthya Karyakram - Uttarakhand
benefit: Under this Programme, medical services are provided to children aged 0–5 years through Special Newborn Care Units (SNCUs), Newborn Stabilization Units (NBSUs), and Nutritional Rehabilitation Centres (NRCs). Additionally, ASHA workers, Anganwadi workers, and ANMs distribute Vitamin A and IFA syrup free of cost to children aged 0–5 years.
_eligibility_text: 1. The beneficiary must be a child between 0 and 5 years of age from Uttarakhand.
